description.value: Fuego Old Town Eatery is a lively, rustic Mexican-style brunch spot established in 2015 in Victoria's historic Old Town neighbourhood. It serves a creative all-day breakfast and lunch menu featuring chorizo, pulled pork, eggs benedict, chilaquiles, and house-made cornbread on a first-come, first-served basis. Its location on Store Street puts it squarely in the heart of Victoria's waterfront cycling corridor.
